items.escena: Three everyday objects grouped on a clay tabletop: a rounded grey stone, a short glass of blue water and a red apple, all modelled in clay
One single rounded clay cube resting alone in the middle of a clay tabletop, with a soft contact shadow and nothing else around it
A clay two-pan balance scale on a table: a small dark metal cube sits on the left pan and three round stacked weights on the right pan, the beam perfectly level
A clay spring scale hanging from a hook, stretched downward by a heavy round ball, with a thick rounded clay arrow beside it pointing straight down to the ground
A tall clay measuring cylinder half filled with blue water standing next to a small stack of four little clay cubes on a table
Two clay cubes of exactly the same size side by side on a balance: the left one pale and airy tilts the beam up, the right one dark and compact pushes its pan down
A clay wooden block on a table with a clay ruler lying along its edge and a small round weight resting on top of it
A clear clay glass of blue water seen from the side: a light wooden block floats on the surface while a small grey metal ball rests at the bottom
A clay block half submerged in a clear tank of blue water, with a thick red clay arrow pointing down from the block and a thick blue clay arrow pointing up from beneath it
